Game Overview

Ouka Bunny Girl is a platformer game built around embark on a thrilling quest as a bunny girl collecting carrots across treacherous landscapes. Navigate pixelated worlds, dodging menacing foes and deadly traps with precision. Master the art of double jumping to traverse challenging levels, all set within charming anime-themed visuals. Can you reach the flag and conquer every obstacle?
